fields.notes: The M_CAN User's Manual does not specify DFT / scan / BIST insertion — M_CAN ships as VHDL RTL synthesis-ready and DFT is added by the integrator at SoC level. M_CAN does provide rich protocol-level self-checking and built-in test features that substitute for traditional BIST at the protocol level:
fields.scan_topology: Not specified — integrator's DFT methodology. Typical SoC-integrated CAN controller IP inserts standard scan chains at the integrator level + per-domain at-speed test (separate scan modes for m_can_hclk and m_can_cclk domains).
fields.atpg_strategy: Not specified — typically full-scan stuck-at + at-speed transition.
